Switchgear
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks I2, which must be performed every two years instead of 
 ten years according to manufacturer letter dated 12 
 Oct 1998 to Sakr Koresh Substation, and as indicated by Y2 in the title
block..
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes ... 
 etc
Ensure that the 
 earthing switch must be disconnected and properly grounded on both sides using 
 portable grounds.
Circuit breaker must be isolated completely and 
 grounded on both sides.
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Multimeter, blower, gas detector, buzzer, screwdriver, and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
Check supply voltage.
Clean protective tube of the position indicator with cleaning agent suitable for plexiglass.
Grease threaded spindle of auxiliary switch.
Check screw joints of electric terminals, if necessary retighten.
Check mechanical connections on the drive and auxiliary switch part for wear.
Grease right-angle gearings.
Grease sliding bearings.
Check shaft sealing in the cover for tightness by sniffing.
Check threaded spindle for wear 1) 2)
Check annular contact and contact rod for contact burn 1) 2)
Check auxiliary switch contacts for correct operation and contact burn.
Check carbon brushes of DC motor if necessary replace.
Check operation of heating resistor.
Carry out test operations.
Check operation of torque clutch.
Check mechanical position indicator.
Check drive operating time and compare with reference values from commissioning.
Open contact compartment and clean internal insulator surface thoroughly.
